about: Recurring cast of Ted type 2 (format "cdesign"), drawn by shorts/design_kit/ted2-cast.jsx: <T2Bust who="sam" x={486} y={1150} T={T} mood="nervous" s={1} /> inside art.jsx (972×1728 card). Moods: calm, happy, nervous, shocked, sad, smug, angry. Use a cast member whenever a scene needs a person; props, objects and extra figures are still drawn per video in the Rename Your Nerves style. Append each episode to the character's history.
style: Flat shapes, no outlines, egg-shaped faces, ink hair, white eyes with ink pupils, soft blush, a big soft coloured circle behind the subject. Reference: shorts/rename-nerves, shorts/styles/ted2/cast-sheet.jpg.

sam.name: Sam
sam.look: swept ink hair, cream shirt, blue backdrop
history: ep 1 (friend-question): stuck for weeks on quitting his job; answers instantly when asked what he would tell a friend (Solomon's paradox)
ep 2 (milgram-obedience): sure he'd have stopped; plays the volunteer at the panel, then refuses and says no out loud (Milgram 1963)

priya.name: Priya
priya.look: long dark hair, mustard top, red backdrop
priya.personality: sharp, confident; knows the trick and explains it
history: ep 1 (semantic-satiation, with Leo): explains the tired-meaning idea behind semantic satiation
ep 2 (because-copier): explains that "because" sounds like a reason, so we stop checking
ep 3 (milgram-obedience): cameo as one of the two volunteers who refuse

leo.name: Leo
leo.look: orange curls, freckles, teal hoodie, yellow backdrop
leo.personality: cheerful, impulsive; falls for every bias first
history: ep 1 (friend-question): cameo as "the friend" in the study scene
ep 2 (semantic-satiation): says "spoon" until it is just a noise; tries it on his own name tag
ep 3 (because-copier): cuts the copier line with "because I have to make copies"

grace.name: Grace
grace.look: grey bun, round glasses, purple cardigan, teal backdrop
grace.personality: wise retired therapist; calm voice of reason
history: ep 1 (friend-question): Sam's neighbour; asks him "what would you tell a friend?"

omar.name: Omar
omar.look: buzz cut, full beard, red top, orange backdrop
omar.personality: competitive and proud; habits, motivation, status
history: ep 1 (because-copier): next in line at the copier; refuses Leo with no reason, then steps aside for an empty "because" (Langer copy-machine study)
